Cost: 2,500eb (Luxury)
Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)
Option Slots: uses 1

Neuralware. Needs to be linked to the Neuroport of at least one other user who has this installed before either works. Linking needs both users within 6m/yds for 9 seconds (3 Rounds) and has to be voluntary on both sides. The link lasts 24 hours or until either user cuts it. Up to 6 users can be linked in one network. While linked users are within 20m/yds of each other, line of sight or not, each gets a +1 Complementary Bonus usable once per Round on any skill check, and each benefits from any active cyberware another linked user has that boosts external senses, detects movement, or scans for signals. Those bonuses apply once each and don't stack across users. Cyberware that negates a Critical Injury or similar affliction (Anti-Dazzle, Cyberspine) is not shared.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
